source: User-supplied BeatStream 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい NIGHTMARE PERFECT recording (640x360, 30 fps)
judgmentRules: SCORE rises in steps of 1e6/2420; taps, Ripples, squares and hold releases add 5 units each, STREAM scores ramp over the path (about 5 units in total).
method: Lane kymographs (854x480 resample, centre 426.5,238) tracked at 342 px/s; arrivals snapped to the 142 BPM sixteenth grid (one global phase, chosen by phrase-start notes against recorded hit sounds). Holds come from ribbon occupancy runs; ribbons that are really STREAM arrows crossing a lane were removed. Ripples come from pink hit bursts at the six circles (+0.05 s to the grid); bursts caused by STREAM ends or the final CLEAR flash were removed. STREAMs were found by scanning template paths (columns, rows, diagonals, squares, zig-zags) for arrow-ribbon coverage; start = last full-coverage frame, end = ribbon gone, both on the grid. A per-frame SCORE reader audits counts; unmatched candidates were checked in cropped frames (rejections below).
unresolved: About 10 recorded judgments (484 implied vs 474 reconstructed) have no confident visual note; none were invented. STREAM paths are template approximations.

audioEdit.sourceAudio: User-supplied 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい / Yuzuki Yukari, UtataP (Original) 320k MP3
audioEdit.method: Video audio is used only to locate the arcade edit. All output samples come from the supplied clean MP3. Band-limited (150-4000 Hz) 1 s waveform correlation gives four constant offsets whose differences are 96, 32 and 98 beats at 142 BPM; 60 ms correlation places each cut on a beat at source 42.7855 s, 90.1119 s and 110.8115 s (cuts inside repeated phrases are estimates). The MP3 ends naturally at about 222.3 s, matching the recording. This is a reconstruction of the arcade edit, not an official audio file.
